# Extract visible user-facing strings from index.html (text content in labels, buttons, titles, help)
python3 << 'PY'
from html.parser import HTMLParser
from pathlib import Path
import re

html = Path('web/index.html').read_text()

# Pull title=, aria-label=, placeholder=, and text between tags for interactive/help elements
titles = re.findall(r'title="([^"]+)"', html)
arias = re.findall(r'aria-label="([^"]+)"', html)
# Get text of li, p, span.param-gloss, button, label, h1-h4, summary, .help, instructions
texts = re.findall(r'>([^<]{2,80})<', html)
# Filter noise
skip = {'true','false','checked','hidden','block','none'}
interesting = []
for t in texts:
    t = ' '.join(t.split())
    if not t or t in skip: continue
    if re.fullmatch(r'[\d\.\sx×/%:+\-←→…✓]*', t): continue
    if t.startswith('{') or t.startswith('http'): continue
    interesting.append(t)

print('=== TITLES ===')
for t in titles: print('-', t)
print('\n=== ARIA ===')
for t in arias: print('-', t)
print('\n=== SAMPLE VISIBLE TEXT (unique) ===')
seen=set()
for t in interesting:
    if t in seen: continue
    seen.add(t)
    if any(c.isalpha() for c in t):
        print('-', t)
PY
